limitations: All four journals now have enumerated 2025 and 2026 issue outputs using official issue-page DOI/article identifiers; counts reflect only issued issue contents and are not projections.

Indexing statuses reflect journal-level statements only, not independent database verification. AJB's official About page claims Zoological Record and ACI inclusion and says the title is not in Web of Science Core Collection; these are not independently checked index records.
JCC official VAST directory confirms pISSN 1813-9663 and four issues/year; no eISSN was exposed in that record or the retrieved issue/profile metadata, so eISSN remains null.

VJMST has 20 eligible article records across its three issued 2026 issues, while the catalog contains a 21st article, DOI 10.15625/1859-3097/24320. Its official article page labels it Forthcoming and assigns it to Online First, not a numbered issue, so it is excluded from issued-issue counts (https://vjs.ac.vn/jmst/article/view/24320).

Issue-page counts differ from the separate catalog article-record counts for AJB: 52 vs. 48 in 2025 and 41 vs. 27 in 2026. The issue-page totals come from enumerating the official issue contents and DOI keys; the catalog aggregate has no one-to-one coverage of those issue contents.
VJBT Vol. 23 No. 1 (2025) is accessible at the official archive's nonnumeric /issue/view/pdf route and is listed under 2025 archive; the URL is unusual but contents were retrieved successfully.
